subject.title: fix(ui): prevent cross-file mock leakage in Control UI tests

question: Should the existing `checks-ui` lane permanently run with `--maxWorkers 3` as a low-worker mock-leakage canary?
rationale: The code repair and dedicated isolation project are mechanically reviewable, but whether a permanent non-default worker-packing check belongs in the normal CI lane is a maintainer-owned coverage-versus-runtime policy choice.

options.title: Keep the three-worker canary
options.body: Land both commits and make low-worker file packing a permanent part of the existing UI CI lane.

options.title: Land only the mock-leakage repair
options.body: Drop the separable CI-canary commit and rely on the existing UI lane while retaining the test isolation and spy conversions.

recommendation.title: Keep the three-worker canary
recommendation.body: Land both commits and make low-worker file packing a permanent part of the existing UI CI lane.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR body explicitly presents the canary as intentionally separable and documents its runtime evidence, making this person the best available routing candidate from the supplied history.
